fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-dc5b5582 at 5f8bfd112: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run Review -v passes, incl. new TestReviewFixerPreHandoffChecklist, which asserts review.md's Fixer section names reproducing the findings, `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render`, the `Checks:` block and exit code; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide passes (review.md 799/800 tokens under the cap; to fit, the builder shortened unrelated review.md wording, e.g. the severity glosses and the merge-base git diff command). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow passes, incl. new TestFixerPromptsNameChecksBlock, which asserts the review.toml fixer prompt and ship-change's ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix prompts each name the `Checks:` block, `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render` and exit code. In the diff, gate-fix-merge and conflict-fix-landed get the same text. Caveat: make self-check in a clean detached checkout of 5f8bfd112 (RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset) fails on a stale render: the claude-code-2be75af1 page is missing (its record came in with the run's evidence commit 4f44e4fb9), and this commit's index.md lists the untracked claude-code-14ab76b3. So the commit's 'make self-check: exit 0' held only in its dirty worktree. Commit a62c7cd14 on cs/pre-handoff-checklist already fixes this render, so no new fix is needed for this leaf.
